newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in after-hours trade on Wednesday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 1.2 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark May contract was unchanged at 147.3 yen.
During the day, the market was supported by falling rubber stocks in Japan and rainfall in rubber-producing countries.
"Rain in producing countries has disrupted the rubber-tapping process, which made sellers here wary of selling aggressively," one trader said.
